root_cause_criterion.criterion: Immediately after `h2o_http2_scheduler_relocate(&(*dst)->_scheduler, &src->_scheduler)`, the relocated scheduler openref stored in the truncated recently-closed-stream stub must no longer be self-active before `preserve_stream_scheduler()` returns it to the scheduler tree.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the stock crashing input, the vulnerable root event records `(*dst)->_scheduler._self_is_active == 1`, so the preserved closed-stream stub remains runnable after relocation. The fixed original records the same root event with `_self_is_active == 0`, matching the added `h2o_http2_scheduler_deactivate(&(*dst)->_scheduler)` call.

nodes.state: At `return stream->_data.size != 0;`, the end of the `_data.size` read lies past the one-past-`_scheduler` boundary of the preserved stub, so the callback reads beyond the truncated recently-closed-stream allocation.

edges.relation: The same relocated scheduler openref left in the preserved closed-stream stub at the root site is the `ref` that later enters `emit_writereq_of_openref()`.
The `h2o_http2_stream_t *stream` reconstructed from that preserved openref in `emit_writereq_of_openref()` is the same `stream` pointer consumed immediately afterward at the pending-data sink.
